phase: Gold enters midweek in a data-heavy, event-driven phase with the Fed firmly on hold as it waits for clarity on the inflation path. The dominant near-term driver is today's US CPI print (Aug 12): headline CPI forecast at 0.1% m/m / 3.4% y/y and core at 0.2% m/m / 2.5% y/y — both showing modest deceleration from prior readings. The prior month's sharp CPI reversal (-0.4% m/m headline) makes the base effect tricky; a beat to the upside would reinforce Fed hawkishness and pressure gold, while a cool or in-line print keeps rate-cut optionality alive and supports gold. The tilt is two-sided into the print, with a slight bearish lean if inflation re-accelerates. Key risk: a hot CPI surprise that reprices Fed cuts sharply lower.
